engine_reference: specifications/ATE/TrendEngine.md (v0.2.0-spec-impl Approved for Research Implementation Planning)
fixture_purpose: TrendEngine behaviour checks. Each fixture is deterministic OHLC with a distinct trend regime. Inert columns (volScore, volShockFlag, confidenceScore, trendScore, momentumScore) are present for loader consistency with the RiskEngine fixtures but are not consumed by the TrendEngine compute path.

up_strong.regime: persistent upward drift with controlled pullbacks to produce higher-high / higher-low structure

down_strong.regime: persistent downward drift with controlled bounces to produce lower-high / lower-low structure

range_choppy.regime: tight oscillation with mean-reverting behaviour; no persistent slope or structure agreement

transition.regime: UP for 0<=i<90, RANGE for 90<=i<160, DOWN for 160<=i<250
transition.expected: regime changes occur; the exact adoption timing depends on trendStructureBars confirmation window

warmup_derivation: trendEmaLen + trendSlopeLookback = 50 + 5 = 55 bars before TrendEngine emits non-UNKNOWN states
compatibility: Fixture loader must accept OHLC + Date and ignore the inert columns (volScore, volShockFlag, confidenceScore, trendScore, momentumScore) when present. These columns are present so the same loader that reads RiskEngine fixtures can also read TrendEngine fixtures.
